subject: biology
introduction: Key units, formulas, and definitions for CSEC Biology — cells, transport, nutrition, respiration, and ecology.

items.name: Magnification
items.formula: magnification = image size / actual size (I = A × M)

items.name: Cell structures
items.formula: nucleus (controls), mitochondria (release energy), chloroplast (photosynthesis), ribosome (protein synthesis)
items.notes: Plant-only: cell wall, chloroplasts, large vacuole. Cell membrane controls entry/exit.

items.name: Diffusion / osmosis / active transport
items.formula: diffusion: high→low, no energy; osmosis: water across a semi-permeable membrane; active: low→high USING energy
items.notes: Turgor: plant cells firm when full of water; plasmolysis in strong salt solution.

items.name: Photosynthesis
items.notes: Chlorophyll traps light; gas exchange via stomata; transpiration stream carries water up the xylem.

items.name: Aerobic respiration
items.notes: In mitochondria; anaerobic in muscles also makes lactic acid.

items.name: Heart pathway
items.formula: vena cava → right atrium → right ventricle → pulmonary artery → lungs → pulmonary vein → left atrium → left ventricle → aorta
items.notes: Left ventricle wall is thickest (pumps to the body). Arteries away from heart; veins have valves; capillaries one cell thick.

items.name: Blood contents
items.formula: red cells (haemoglobin carries O₂), white cells (fight infection), platelets (clot), plasma (~90% water, transports)
items.notes: Pulse = surge of blood; pacemaker (sinoatrial node) sets the beat.

items.name: Balanced diet + deficiencies
items.notes: Iron→anaemia; calcium→bones/teeth; vitamin C→scurvy; vitamin D→rickets; iodine→goitre.

items.name: Kidney / homeostasis
items.formula: nephron filters blood → urine; homeostasis = constant internal environment
items.notes: Insulin lowers blood sugar (lack → diabetes); skin/kidneys regulate water and temperature.

items.name: Nervous vs hormonal
items.formula: nerves: fast, short-lived electrical impulses via neurones; hormones: slower chemical messengers in blood
items.notes: Reflex arc bypasses the brain for speed; adrenaline = fight-or-flight.

items.name: Eye / ear anchors
items.formula: iris controls light entry; retina (rods/cones) detects it; lens focuses
items.notes: Cochlea converts vibrations to nerve impulses.

items.name: Mitosis vs meiosis
items.formula: mitosis: 2 identical cells (growth/repair); meiosis: 4 different gametes (half chromosomes)
items.notes: Human body cells: 46 chromosomes (23 pairs); gametes: 23.

items.name: Monohybrid cross
items.formula: dominant (B) masks recessive (b): Bb × bb → 50% brown, 50% white
items.notes: Genotype = alleles (Bb); phenotype = appearance; homozygous = BB/bb, heterozygous = Bb.

items.name: Seed / foetal growth
items.formula: pollen + ovule → seed; placenta supplies foetus (food/O₂) and removes waste
items.notes: Reproduction vocab: ovary/testes, uterus, gestation, zygote → embryo → foetus.

items.name: Food chains / webs
items.formula: arrows show ENERGY flow: producer → primary consumer → secondary consumer
items.notes: Decomposers recycle nutrients; trophic level with most energy = producers.

items.name: Pyramids of energy
items.formula: only ~10% passed to each next level
items.notes: Explains why food chains rarely exceed 4–5 levels.

items.name: Eutrophication
items.formula: fertilizer run-off → algal bloom → death/decay uses O₂ → aquatic life dies
items.notes: Also: deforestation, greenhouse gases (CO₂, methane), pollution of water by sewage/chemicals.

items.name: Classification order
items.formula: kingdom → phylum → class → order → family → genus → species
items.notes: Humans: Homo sapiens ('Homo' = genus). Binomial = genus + species.
